# Victor Svizev

> Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer with 9+ years of experience in extension development, platform upgrades, compatibility engineering, Hyvä Theme, Adobe App Builder, and AI-assisted development. Based in Dresden, Germany; remote-first.

Certified Adobe Commerce Developer Expert (AD0-E725). Independent Magento extension vendor (VCT) on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace with 100+ sales across 4 extensions and a 5.0 rating. Currently working at TechDivision GmbH, maintaining an ecosystem of 140+ Magento extensions, developing Hyvä Theme / Hyvä Checkout compatibility modules and Adobe App Builder applications, and building internal Claude Code and OpenCode plugins used company-wide. Languages: Russian (native), German (professional working proficiency, telc B2), English (technical reading and written communication, limited spoken).
